product_overview: Backend API for a Greek food distribution company's warehouse operations in Bulgaria. Provides authentication, product/inventory management, incoming/outgoing document processing with AI OCR assistance, accounting exports, and analytics.
core_goals: Secure JWT authentication and role-based access control (admin, warehouse, accountant).
Complete product, category, supplier, partner, and batch CRUD with batch-level stock tracking and FEFO fulfillment.
Process incoming goods with AI OCR invoice scanning and automatic product matching via aliases, creating batches on confirmation.
Create and manage orders, generate invoices (PDF/email), record payments (manual and auto-match), and support accounting export (Delta Pro CP1251).
Provide analytics, notifications, and import/export utilities (XLSX import, CP1251 export) for operational visibility.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: User login, logout, registration and current profile access using JWT tokens with role-based enforcement.
user_flows: POST /auth/login with valid email/password -> Receive 200 with {token, user: {id, name, email, role}} -> GET /auth/me with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with user profile
POST /auth/login with invalid password -> Receive 401 with authentication error message

POST /auth/logout with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {message} -> GET /auth/me with same token -> Receive 401 (token treated as expired/invalid by server-side/session rules or client should discard token)

features.name: Users Management
features.description: Admin-only listing, creation, role changes and deletion of application users.
user_flows: GET /users with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>?page=1&limit=20 -> Receive 200 with {data: [...], pagination: {total, page, limit, pages}}
POST /users with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and valid user payload -> Receive 200 with {id, name, email, role, created_at}
POST /users with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 403 authorization error

PATCH /users/123/role with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and {role: 'accountant'} -> Receive 200 with updated user -> DELETE /users/123 with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> -> Receive 200 {message}
DELETE /users/999 with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> for non-existent id -> Receive 404 {message: 'User not found'}

features.name: Products
features.description: Create, read, update and delete products; support filters (category, brand, search), brand listing and per-product stock view.
user_flows: POST /products with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and valid product payload -> Receive 201 {product}
GET /products?brand=Acme&search=olive&low_stock=true with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...], pagination}
GET /products/42 with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 200 {product}
GET /products/42/stock with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 200 {product_id, total_stock, name_bg, name_en, batches: [...]}
PUT /products/42 with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and invalid payload (missing required field) -> Receive 400 validation error
DELETE /products/42 with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 403 if only admin may delete

features.name: Categories
features.description: Manage product categories (list, create, delete).
user_flows: GET /categories with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...]}
POST /categories with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and valid payload -> Receive 201 {id, name_bg, name_en}
DELETE /categories/10 with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> -> Receive 200 {success: true}
POST /categories with Authorization: Bearer <token_without_admin_role> -> Receive 403 authorization error

features.name: Product Aliases
features.description: Manage supplier-specific product name aliases used by the AI OCR matching service; supports lookup and bulk upsert.
user_flows: POST /product-aliases with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and {alias_name, product_id, supplier_id} -> Receive 200 {id, alias_name, product_id, supplier_id}
GET /product-aliases?product_id=42 with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...]}
GET /product-aliases/lookup?name=Olive%20Oil%20Big%20Bottle with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {match: {product_id, score, alias_id}}
POST /product-aliases/bulk with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and large list -> Receive 200 {data: [...]}
DELETE /product-aliases/999 with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> for non-existent alias -> Receive 404 {message}

features.name: Suppliers
features.description: Create, update, list and delete suppliers used for incoming goods and alias mapping.
user_flows: POST /suppliers with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and valid supplier payload -> Receive 201 {supplier}
GET /suppliers?search=Greek with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...]}
PUT /suppliers/55 with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and changes -> Receive 200 {supplier}
DELETE /suppliers/55 with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> -> Receive 200 {success: true}
PUT /suppliers/999 with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> for non-existent id -> Receive 404 {message}

features.name: Inventory
features.description: View current stock levels with batch details, list low-stock products and batches expiring soon.
user_flows: GET /inventory?page=1&limit=50 with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...], pagination}
GET /inventory/low-stock with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...], count}
GET /inventory/expiring?within_days=14 with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...], count, within_days}
GET /inventory with Authorization: missing or invalid token -> Receive 401 authentication error

features.name: Batches
features.description: Create, update, list and delete batches with expiry dates used for FEFO fulfillment.
user_flows: POST /batches with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> and valid batch payload -> Receive 201 {batch}
GET /batches?product_id=42 with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...], pagination}
GET /batches/expiring?within_days=30 with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...], count, within_days}
PUT /batches/101 with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> and invalid date format -> Receive 400 validation error
DELETE /batches/101 with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 200 {message, id}

features.name: Incoming Goods
features.description: Create incoming delivery documents, upload scans for AI OCR processing, generate stock receipt PDFs, and confirm deliveries to add batches to inventory.
user_flows: POST /incoming/scan with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> and multipart form file upload (invoice PDF) -> Receive 200 {normalized_data, matched_products}
POST /incoming with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> and document + items -> Receive 201 {document, items, total_amount}
GET /incoming/123 with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 200 {document, items: [...]}
GET /incoming/123/receipt with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 200 PDF file
PUT /incoming/123/confirm with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 200 {message, items_count} -> GET /inventory to verify batches added -> Receive 200 with updated stock
POST /incoming/scan with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> but external AI OCR service unreachable -> Receive 502 or 503 external service error
PUT /incoming/999/confirm with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> for non-existent document -> Receive 404 {message}

features.name: Orders
features.description: Create and manage customer orders, import from Comarch ERP, view order details, update status, and fulfill using FEFO stock depletion.
user_flows: POST /orders with Authorization: Bearer <token> and valid order payload -> Receive 201 {order, items, total_amount, stock_warnings}
POST /orders/from-comarch with Authorization: Bearer <token> and comarch payload -> Receive 200 {order, items, comarch_order_id}
GET /orders/77 with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {order, items: [...]}

POST /orders/77/fulfill with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 200 {message, order_id} -> GET /products/42/stock to confirm FEFO batches were decremented -> Receive 200 {batches: [...]}
PUT /orders/77/status with Authorization: Bearer <token> and {status: 'cancelled'} -> Receive 200 {order}
POST /orders with Authorization: Bearer <token> containing item not in stock -> Receive 201 with stock_warnings indicating insufficient stock or backorder info

features.name: Invoices
features.description: Generate PDF invoices for orders, download PDFs, send invoices by email and create credit notes (admin/accountant).
user_flows: POST /invoices with Authorization: Bearer <accountant_token> and {order_id: 77} -> Receive 201 {invoice, pdf_path}
GET /invoices/:id/pdf with Authorization: Bearer <accountant_token> -> Receive 200 PDF file
POST /invoices/:id/send-email with Authorization: Bearer <accountant_token> and {email} -> Receive 200 {message, email}
POST /invoices/credit-note with Authorization: Bearer <accountant_token> and valid payload -> Receive 201 {credit_note, pdf_path}
GET /invoices/unpaid with Authorization: Bearer <accountant_token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...], count}
POST /invoices with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 403 (accountant/admin only)

features.name: Payments
features.description: Record manual payments, list payments and support auto-matching of incoming payments from email agent.
user_flows: POST /payments with Authorization: Bearer <accountant_token> and valid payment payload -> Receive 201 {payment, invoice_total, total_paid, remaining}
POST /payments/auto-match with Authorization: Bearer <accountant_token> and {email_payload_reference} -> Receive 200 {payment, matched_invoice, partner_name}
GET /payments?partner_id=12 with Authorization: Bearer <accountant_token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...]}
POST /payments with Authorization: Bearer <accountant_token> but missing amount -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Partners
features.description: Manage customers/partners, search partners and manage partner-specific price lists.
user_flows: POST /partners with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and valid payload -> Receive 201 {partner}
GET /partners?search=Retail&page=1 with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...], pagination}
GET /partners/22/price-list with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {partner_id, price_list, items: [...]}
PUT /partners/22/price-list with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and valid price items -> Receive 200 {message, price_list_id, items_updated}
PUT /partners/999 with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> for missing partner -> Receive 404 {message}

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Fetch active alerts (low stock, expiring batches), mark as read and dismiss notifications.
user_flows: GET /notifications with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...], count}
PUT /notifications/45/read with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {ok: true}
POST /notifications/read-all with Authorization: Bearer <token> and {ids: [1,2,3]} -> Receive 200 {ok: true}
DELETE /notifications/45 with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {ok: true}
GET /notifications with Authorization: missing token -> Receive 401 authentication error

features.name: Analytics and Dashboard
features.description: Sales analytics, top products, stock forecasting, anomaly detection and dashboard KPIs with daily/monthly reports.
user_flows: GET /analytics/dashboard with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {today_orders, today_revenue, total_stock_value, low_stock_count, pending_payments, expiring_soon_count}
GET /analytics/sales?from=2026-02-01&to=2026-02-28 with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...], summary: {total_revenue, total_orders, period}}
GET /analytics/top-products?period=monthly with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...], period}

GET /analytics/report/daily?date=2026-03-01 with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {date, total_orders, total_revenue, total_items_sold, new_stock_received, payments_collected, low_stock_alerts}
GET /analytics/stock-forecast with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 {data: [...]}
GET /analytics/report/monthly with Authorization: Bearer <token> but invalid month format -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Settings
features.description: Retrieve and save company settings; admin-only modification.
user_flows: GET /settings with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> -> Receive 200 {id, company_name, address, eik, vat_number, iban, phone, email, updated_at}
POST /settings with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and valid payload -> Receive 200 {settings}
POST /settings with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 403 authorization error

features.name: Export (Delta Pro)
features.description: Export invoices/accounts to Delta Pro CP1251-encoded file for Bulgarian accounting.
user_flows: GET /export/delta-pro?from=2026-02-01&to=2026-02-28 with Authorization: Bearer <accountant_token> -> Receive 200 File (CP1251 encoded text)
GET /export/delta-pro with Authorization: Bearer <token> missing proper role -> Receive 403 authorization error

features.name: Import (XLSX)
features.description: Bulk import partners and products from Microinvest XLSX sheets, returning counts of inserted/updated/skipped and error details.
user_flows: POST /import/partners with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and multipart XLSX file (DOSTAVCHICI/PRODAJBI) -> Receive 200 {message, file, inserted, updated, skipped, errors, error_details}
POST /import/products with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> and multipart XLSX file (STOKI) -> Receive 200 {message, file, inserted, updated, skipped, errors, error_details}
POST /import/products with Authorization: Bearer <admin_token> but malformed XLSX -> Receive 400 with error_details describing parsing errors
POST /import/partners with Authorization: Bearer <warehouse_token> -> Receive 403 authorization error
